name: Senbatsu Keibitai
source:
You are a guard and your current duty is to guard a lone princess with other guards disguised as princess friends and relatives in accordance with the last order of the king.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名卫兵，当前任务是根据国王遗命，与其他伪装成公主朋友和亲属的卫兵一同守护一名孤身公主。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
